name: FrogFloatingActionButton
description: A prominent floating contextual action with regular, small, and extended presentations, accessible naming, and reduced-motion fallbacks.

accessibility.talkBackNotes: contentDescription is mandatory for all presentations. When hidden, the button is removed completely from the accessibility tree and interaction. Minimum 48dp touch target is guaranteed even for Small FAB.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Primary visual glyph composable. Should use contentDescription = null since the parent button owns the accessible name.

properties.name: contentDescription
properties.description: Mandatory concise action description announced by accessibility services.

properties.name: onClick
properties.description: Callback invoked when the button is activated via touch, keyboard, or accessibility action.

properties.name: modifier
properties.description: Layout modifier applied to the outer touch-target container.

properties.name: presentation
properties.description: Visual presentation form: Regular (56dp), Small (40dp), or Extended (48dp height).

properties.name: label
properties.description: Composable visible text label used when presentation is Extended.

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: When true and presentation is Extended, displays both icon and label. When false, collapses to icon-only. Ignored for Regular and Small.

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Controls interaction state. When false, clicks are suppressed and visual style becomes muted.

properties.name: visible
properties.description: Controls presence. When false, smoothly animates out and is removed from semantics and interaction.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: Elevation tokens controlling shadow and surface separation across resting, pressed, and focused states.

properties.name: colors
properties.description: Resolved container, content, disabled, and interaction colors.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: Corner radius shape applied to the FAB container.

properties.name: interactionSource
properties.description: Interaction stream driving press animations and focus rings.

examples.title: Regular FAB
examples.description: Default prominent floating action button for screen-level actions.

examples.title: Small FAB
examples.description: Compact floating action button maintaining the 48dp minimum touch target.

examples.title: Extended FAB
examples.description: Floating action with icon and visible text label.

examples.title: Collapsing Extended FAB
examples.description: Extended FAB with caller-toggled expansion state.

examples.title: Scroll-Aware FAB
examples.description: Demonstrates screen-driven visibility and expansion based on list scroll direction.

examples.title: Inset-Aware Placement
examples.description: Positioning a FAB at the bottom-end above navigation bars and system insets.
